judgement.why_this_decision: The rules say never to pass on an invoice that doesn't match the approved quote or the contractor of record. TS-0882 fails on payee, amount and scope. Two invoices for one job also make TS-0881 ambiguous until the contractor confirms which is valid. The landlord pays invoices herself, so she needed to be told to hold payment.

alternatives_considered.option: Tell the landlord to pay TS-0881 now and reject only TS-0882
alternatives_considered.why_not: Until the contractor confirms which invoice is real, there's a risk of paying the wrong payee or paying twice. A short delay is safer.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord to approve the extra £114
alternatives_considered.why_not: There's no evidence the extra labour happened and the payee doesn't match the contractor, so the invoice needs clarifying before any approval request.
